statement:
∀ v ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1,
  ∀ q ∈ square 1,
    (Relation.EqvGen (glue 1) (0, v) q ↔ q = (0, v) ∨ q = (1, v)) ∧
      ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1, Relation.EqvGen (glue 1) (u, v) q ↔ q = (u, v)

# name: set-edge-interior-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Quotients.edge_interior_classes
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1/2', '(by norm_num)', '(1, 1/2)', '(by simp [KaluzaKlein.Sets.Quotients.square]; norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (v : ℝ) (hv : v ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) (q : ℝ × ℝ) (hq : q ∈ square 1), (Relation.EqvGen (glue 1) (0, v) q ↔ q = (0, v) ∨ q = (1, v)) ∧ (∀ u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, Relation.EqvGen (glue 1) (u, v) q ↔ q = (u, v)) := by
  intro v hv q hq
  obtain ⟨hv0, hv1⟩ := hv
  have hmem : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u → u ≤ 1 → (u, v) ∈ square 1 := fun u h1 h2 => ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, ⟨hv0.le, hv1.le⟩⟩
  have hb : ∀ b : ℝ, (v = b ∨ (v = 0 ∧ b = 1) ∨ (v = 1 ∧ b = 0)) ↔ b = v := by
    intro b
    constructor
    · rintro (h | ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩)
      · exact h.symm
      · linarith
      · linarith
    · intro h; left; exact h.symm
  constructor
  · rw [glue_eqvGen_iff 1 one_pos _ q (hmem 0 le_rfl zero_le_one) hq, κ_eq_iff 1 _ _ one_pos,
      κ_eq_iff 1 _ _ one_pos]
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := q
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
    rw [hb b]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h | ⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩, hbv⟩
      · left; exact ⟨h.symm, hbv⟩
      · right; exact ⟨h, hbv⟩
      · norm_num at h
    · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) <;> simp
  · intro u hu
    obtain ⟨hu0, hu1⟩ := hu
    rw [glue_eqvGen_iff 1 one_pos _ q (hmem u hu0.le hu1.le) hq, κ_eq_iff 1 _ _ one_pos,
      κ_eq_iff 1 _ _ one_pos]
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := q
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
    rw [hb b]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h | ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩, hbv⟩
      · exact ⟨h.symm, hbv⟩
      · linarith
      · linarith
    · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨Or.inl rfl, by simp⟩
